workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Web UI unusable after image upgrade — cached index.html served without no-store, missing chunks answered with 200 text/html, stale bundle calls a removed endpoint
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(docker): stop the SPA fallback from masking stale hashed assets. Target files: docker/nginx/ragflow.conf, docker/nginx/ragflow.https.conf. An in-place image upgrade (rc2 → rc3) left browsers that had the app open in an unrecoverable state, and the report identified two server-side enablers: (Ref: https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow/pull/21878)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Timeout for longer query / answer - context has been canceled: context canceled
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(agentic-rag): make the finalize and claims budgets configurable. Target files: internal/agentic_rag/agent.go, internal/agentic_rag/agent_env_timeout_test.go. (Ref: https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow/pull/21879)
